title: Development to QA Handoff Artifact
description: Structured artifact produced by the Development Orchestrator and consumed by the QA Orchestrator. Contains the source code manifest, test coverage summary, dependency list, layer compliance summary, and any known issues.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema used to produce the artifact.

projectName.description: Human-readable name of the target project as configured in This Project.

sourceCodeManifest.description: List of all source files created during development with their layer classification and description.

filePath.description: Relative file path within the project repository.

layer.description: Clean Architecture layer this file belongs to.

description.description: What this file contains and its role in the system.

testCoverageSummary.description: Summary of test coverage metrics across all test types.

coveragePercent.description: Statement coverage percentage for domain and application layers.

overallCoveragePercent.description: Aggregate statement coverage percentage across all test types.

dependencyList.description: All external runtime dependencies with their versions and license information.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for this dependency.

layerComplianceSummary.description: Clean Architecture layer compliance status for each layer.

domain.description: Compliance status for the domain layer.

compliant.description: True if no dependency rule violations were found in this layer.

violations.description: List of any dependency rule violations found. Empty if compliant.

application.description: Compliance status for the application layer.

compliant.description: True if no dependency rule violations were found in this layer.

violations.description: List of any dependency rule violations found.

adapters.description: Compliance status for the adapters layer.

compliant.description: True if no dependency rule violations were found in this layer.

violations.description: List of any dependency rule violations found.

infrastructure.description: Compliance status for the infrastructure layer.

compliant.description: True if no dependency rule violations were found in this layer.

violations.description: List of any dependency rule violations found.

knownIssues.description: Any known limitations, deferred items, or technical debt carried forward from Development. Empty array if none.

description.description: What the issue is and where it manifests.

deferralReason.description: Why this issue was not resolved during Development.

ticketKey.description: Optional validated TICKET_KEY scoping this run to knowledge-base/plans/active/<TICKET_KEY>/. Must match the pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[1-9][0-9]*$. Absent for offline runs.

sessionPath.description: Optional active artifact directory derived from ticketKey. Defaults to knowledge-base/plans/active/ when absent.
